groups.label: native_auth_identity
groups.deadline_policy: one shared original group deadline including all listing and runs; clipped to original 12000 outer

tests.name: native_jwt_local_service_token_identity_renewal_and_cold_reopen
tests.required_observation: real local service login, same assertion twice, one entity, cold value, expired-assertion renewal after key rotation, revoke/unmount
tests.limit: Missing Token API child/batch/mixed-origin cases are separately flagged.

tests.name: native_jwt_rejects_remote_batch_and_bad_signature_without_candidate_delta
tests.required_observation: remote JWT/batch JWT/bad signature fail closed; complete relevant Auth/Identity projection unchanged
tests.limit: Does not test Token API batch issuance by a JWT actor.

tests.name: native_jwt_role_operations_keep_the_existing_legacy_acl_contract
tests.required_observation: current legacy role collection GET/list and named DELETE/update+sudo; no-sudo denial
tests.limit: Not an OpenBao ACL oracle result.

tests.name: native_jwt_identity_failure_does_not_export_witness_or_token_and_next_login_is_fresh
tests.required_observation: disabled actual Identity after verification; no returned witness/token; later fresh success

tests.name: native_jwt_original_assertion_expiry_before_publication_keeps_auth_identity_atomic
tests.required_observation: original assertion expires after real authentication before plan; logical root unchanged and cold check
tests.limit: No claim that every lower-level unknown I/O writes zero bytes.

tests.name: native_jwt_native_owner_capacity_veto_after_authentication_keeps_the_old_root
tests.required_observation: real owner-capacity gate 507 after authentication; root fits but candidate does not
tests.limit: Known prepublication capacity veto, not unknown I/O injection.

tests.name: native_jwt_original_assertion_expiry_after_commit_withholds_reply_without_rollback
tests.required_observation: real committed root; assertion expiry during actual audit vetoes delivery

tests.name: native_jwt_post_commit_audit_failure_keeps_whole_root_and_recovery_required
tests.required_observation: actual mandatory audit capacity failure; complete root retained/recovery required
tests.limit: No automatic retry or token reissue.

tests.name: native_jwt_post_audit_response_and_original_deadline_cannot_be_rebound
tests.required_observation: audited status tamper plus original deadline expiry

tests.name: native_jwt_post_audit_revocation_cannot_replace_the_original_publication_proof
tests.required_observation: actual owner/proof held across separately authorized real revoke; stale delivery rejected
tests.limit: Actual original proof reused only for rejection; cold revoked token denied.

tests.name: native_jwt_token_api_service_descendants_keep_own_renewal_and_parent_revocation
tests.required_observation: Real JWT parent, service child and grandchild; cold entity/path; child renewal after role deletion/assertion expiry; original direct JWT renewal rejection; parent revoke and cold denial.

tests.name: native_jwt_token_api_batch_owner_preserves_real_parent_binding_across_cold_reopen
tests.required_observation: Actual TokenApi batch grants from JWT parent and TokenApi service child, existing sealed issuer/lifecycle; cold use, non-renewability and parent revocation.

tests.name: native_jwt_token_api_revoke_orphan_keeps_own_issuer_but_mount_retirement_still_revokes
tests.required_observation: Real revoke-orphan, child's own renewal after role deletion/cold reopen, then mount-disable retirement and cold rejection.

tests.name: native_jwt_and_userpass_token_api_targets_keep_real_owner_and_renewal_in_both_directions
tests.required_observation: Real JWT/Userpass logins, cross-target renewal with same credentials and cold cross-revocation; independent JWT survivor.

tests.name: native_jwt_token_api_profile_rejects_mount_label_without_real_issuer_or_parent_graph
tests.required_observation: Seven negative detached format/profile values from actual issued child; no forged state installed; real fixture and child unchanged.
